CAP. 253] Patents
4
CHAPTER 253
10 of 2001. PATENTS ACT (COMMENCEMENT) ORDER
Act 14 of 2000.
(Section 73)
[ 3rd February, 2001.]
Short title. 1. This Order may be cited as the
PATENTS ACT (COMMENCEMENT) ORDER.
Commencement 2. In exercise of the powers vested in me by section 73 of the Patents
of Chapter 253. Act and all other powers thereunto me enabling, I, GODFREY SMITH,
Minister responsible for Patents, do hereby appoint the 5th day of January,
2001, as the day on which the said Act shall come into force.
MADE this 4th day of January, 2001.
(GODFREY SMITH)
Minister responsible for Patents
